title: Performance of Handles and Handle Assemblies Attached to Cookware - Specification ( First Revision )
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies safety and performance requirements for the handles and knobs on items of cookware for use on the top of a stove or any other heating appliance and: a) Fixing systems used for attachment to the cookware; b) Cookware regardless of material or method of manufacture with the exceptions of glass, ceramic and glass ceramic articles; and с) Cookware intended for use both “on top” and “in oven". 1.2 This standard does not cover: a) Any other requirements for cookware; and b) Items of ovenware specifically confined to use within the oven. NOTE — Handles, knobs and fixing systems are tested as complete items of cookware.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
